elements.description:
A placeholder block with a soft band of light sweeping over it. Hidden from assistive tech unless the page sets
aria-hidden itself.

elements.description:
A label with a brighter band running through its letters, like an AI "Thinking…" state. The label stays readable;
the brighter copy in the band is hidden from assistive tech.

changelog: The 22 illustrations and 8 motion pieces as elements (step 2.7), 105 tags in all; shimmer-loader is two (`tc-skeleton`, `tc-shimmer-text`). Same React names and props through `trenchcoat/react`; parity with the React versions at 0.00 % except voice-orb's canvas particles (timing) and tilt-card, which drops 3 px of line space under its inline-block root.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
